# netbox_ip_ranges (Data Source)

Lists ip_range objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ip_ranges" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: contains, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, end_address, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, mark_utilized, owner_id, owner_id__n, role, role__n, role_id, role_id__n, start_address, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tenant, tenant__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n, vrf, vrf__n, vrf_id, vrf_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `ip_ranges` (Attributes List) The matching ip_ranges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_ranges))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--ip_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `end_address` (String) Last address of the range with its mask, e.g. 10.0.0.50/24.
- `family` (Number) Address family: 4 or 6.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `mark_populated` (Boolean) Treat the range as fully populated.
- `mark_utilized` (Boolean) Treat the range as fully utilized.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the IPAM role.
- `size` (Number) Number of addresses in the range.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the range with its mask, e.g. 10.0.0.1/24.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: active, reserved, deprecated.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `url` (String)
- `vrf_id` (Number) Id of the VRF.
